dedupe_keys.name: fcc protected fixed satellite service earth station registrations

description: Published by the Federal Communications Commission, this dataset lists the earth station antennas of the fixed-satellite service in the United States that are registered for protection in the FCC's FSS Antenna Registration System, a daily transfer of the registry that the FCC set up when the 3.7 to 4.2 GHz C-band was repurposed for mobile use. Each of the 469 rows gives the registration number, call sign and licensee, the site coordinates and elevation, antenna height above ground and sea level, antenna gain, pointing azimuth and elevation, the longitude of the geostationary satellite it points to, the frequency range, whether it is used for tracking, telemetry and command, and the certification and update dates. Coverage: the United States, site level, updated daily (last data update 10 September 2026). Format and access: a table through the Socrata API with CSV and JSON export, free as US government data; attachments are a separate dataset. Caveats: only stations that registered for protection are listed; receive-only stations that did not register are missing. Simulation uses: an asset inventory of satellite ground infrastructure for hazard exposure and interference and capacity planning with terrestrial 5G. Related records: the ITU space network list gives satellite filings and ULS gives terrestrial licences.
